relationships.subject: HIV-1 gp120
relationships.evidence_quote: Here, we show microglia- and astrocyte-mediated synaptic pruning of excitatory and inhibitory synapses in the frontal cortex (FC) and spinal dorsal horn (SDH) of HIV-1 gp120 transgenic (gp120Tg) mice compared with the wild-type (WT).

relationships.subject: Galectin-3
relationships.evidence_quote: We recently suggested that gal-3 was critical for the gp120-induced formation of HIPAs because HIPAs did not form after gal-3 was knocked out (KO).

relationships.subject: HIPA
relationships.evidence_quote: This result suggests that in the gp120Tg model, HIPAs are a major astrocytic subtype that has markedly higher activity in synaptic pruning.

key_findings: In gp120Tg mice microglia and astrocytes prune excitatory and inhibitory synapses in a region- and synapse-type-specific manner; astrocytes prune only excitatory synapses.
Gal-3-dependent HIPA astrocytes are a major pruning subtype.
